Reminder.title: Reminder
Reminder.description: An AI-organized voice or text reminder note with optional scheduled push alert timestamp.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the reminder owner.

topic.description: Concise notification headline and note title (1-100 chars).

organizedNote.description: AI-structured clean text note or bulleted summary (0-2000 chars).

rawTranscript.description: Verbatim voice transcript or original typed entry (0-2000 chars).

category.description: Minimalist category tag assigned by AI or edited by the user.

scheduledAtEpochMillis.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds extracted from the mentioned time for local push alert scheduling.

completed.description: Whether the reminder has been marked as done.

completedAtEpochMillis.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds when the reminder was completed (used for 20-item archive ordering).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-modified timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/reminders/{reminderId}.description: Per-user collection of up to 20 AI-processed voice reminders.
